questions.prompt: Which statement of the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) is correct?

options.text: A function should do only one thing
A module should have one reason to change — be responsible to one actor
A class should have only one method
A file should contain only one class

questions.explanation: SRP is about having a single reason to change / responsibility to one actor. 'Do one thing' is a common misquote.

questions.prompt: The Liskov Substitution Principle is named after Barbara Liskov and requires that:

options.text: Subtypes must be substitutable for their base types without breaking callers
Every class must have a base class

questions.explanation: LSP (Barbara Liskov) is about substitutability: code using a base type must keep working with any subtype. Small interfaces are ISP; depending on abstractions is DIP.

questions.prompt: The Open-Closed Principle says software should be open for extension but ______ for modification.
questions.explanation: OCP: add new behavior by adding code, not by modifying existing, depended-on code.

questions.prompt: Match each SOLID letter to its principle.
questions.explanation: SOLID = SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP, DIP. Clean Architecture applies these at the scale of components and layers.

questions.prompt: Order the SOLID principles as the acronym spells them.
questions.explanation: S-O-L-I-D: Single Responsibility, Open-Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion.

questions.prompt: Which statements about the Interface Segregation Principle (ISP) are true? Select all that apply.

options.text: Don't force clients to depend on methods they don't use
Prefer several small, focused interfaces over one fat interface
Every class must implement every interface
A client depending on a fat interface can be forced to recompile when unrelated methods change

questions.explanation: ISP argues against fat interfaces because clients get coupled to methods they never call, spreading unrelated changes. Requiring every class to implement every interface is not ISP.
